spec.description: The primary formatting pattern the assistant uses for all of its message steps.

labels.consistent_numbered_lists: All assistant message steps organize their content into numbered or ordered list items.
labels.mixed_format: Assistant message steps use a mix of structured lists and unstructured paragraph text.

spec.name: assistant_response_format

value.reason: The original definition included an unclear requirement that every numbered list must be followed by a single concluding summary paragraph, which created ambiguous boundaries and led to differing judgments about responses that contain lists without the specified concluding paragraph structure.
